exposure: Botanical composition of standardized fenugreek seed extract (IDM01) containing 4-hydroxyisoleucine and trigonelline
cohort: Pregnant rats were administered IDM01 or a vehicle control during gestational days 5-19.
finding: Prenatal oral exposure of IDM01 up to 500 mg/kg/day during organogenesis in pregnant rats resulted in no observed adverse effects on maternal or fetal developmental parameters.
